calibrations.scope: Joint economic stress design changing coupling, terminal dispersion preference, feasible actor radius and initial heterogeneity; no single-primitive causal attribution.

confirmation.paired_transfer: Fixed before confirmation; independent general-primitive audit required before accepting any refined endpoint.
confirmation.target_scope: One prespecified final decision after the complete fixed fit; not an early-stopping frontier.

economic_decisions.absolute_accuracy: Display the newly computed full-adapted-class anchor-minus-gain regret upper bound beside every high-dimensional schedule gain; positive improvement is not near-optimality.

failures.numerical_or_confirmation: Retain failure and invalidate completeness; no favorable replacement or omitted method.
failures.selection: Independent residual may select only prespecified candidates/checkpoints; ties choose earliest declared position.
failures.training: Retain failure and all work; deploy the analytical schedule with exact gain zero, never replace its seed.

freeze_gate: All four calibrations, eight seeds, training schedules and HJB selection rules fixed.
All simulator aliases, proof constants, clipping/tail and source closures independently checked.
Immutable source branch pushed before any confirmation bank is generated.
Development smoke banks cannot use any registered confirmation domain or seed.
Every registered calibration, stream and method retained regardless of outcome.
freeze_scope: All economic and statistical choices are fixed in this file; the immutable Git source commit containing the completed implementations and deterministic accounts must precede every confirmation bank. No source commit is self-embedded.

inference.count_formula: 4 calibrations * 2 dimensions * (5 schedule gains + 4 NBO direct contrasts) * (8 conditional stream intervals + 1 complete finite-stream mean)
inference.pooled_scope: Uniform mean over all eight declared streams, separately for each economic calibration and dimension.
inference.statistic: Independent, possibly nonidentically distributed common-path paired observations; exact rational moments and outward empirical-Bernstein endpoints.

retained_history: All R15 original fits, online stops, confirmation banks, post-freeze paired reanalysis and adverse results remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
seed_draw_law: Uniform distinct 31-bit seeds; rejection only for an exact duplicate before any fit.
seed_scope: Eight distinct 31-bit seeds drawn once from the operating-system random source before any family fit. The inferential target remains their explicitly frozen finite uniform distribution, conditional on this draw; no extrapolation to all optimizer randomness.
strong_hjb_selection: Four prespecified exact-trace fit configurations; independent exact residual selection only. Greedy and distilled deployments are both frozen outputs, with no final-payoff selection.

training.actor_loss: identical reference-postdecision Hamiltonian linearization for NBO and raw_costate; NBO uses learned q, raw_costate the same four-antithetic mean targets; all labels reusable
training.budget_unit: cumulative independent reference-occupation states; no assertion of equal floating-point or simulator work across methods
training.critic_architecture: known lift plus (T-t_after)*(time_MLP_16_16 + spatial_MLP_32_32/d); Tanh hidden layers, zero output initialization; postdecision for NBO, original full-value lift for neural_hjb

critic_lbfgs.counting: max_iter and max_eval are optimizer settings; finish the current line search and record every actual closure, derivative, and accepted iteration

training.direct_policy_objective: four-antithetic complete 64-cell transformed-payoff gradient from population initial states; all simulator/backward work counted
training.fine_grid_scope: trained64-cell scalar critic is a fixed predictor on audit2048 dates; measured bridge error includes all training-to-audit discretization discrepancy, without a zero-bias claim
training.hjb_objective: product of two conditionally independent Hutchinson residual estimates; four total Hessian probes per collocation batch
training.nbo_spatial_objective: full-replay d-scaled costate Sobolev MSE; no value-level gradients update spatial parameters
training.nbo_time_objective: value MSE updates the time-only intercept with the fitted spatial residual held fixed
training.occupation_time_law: uniform over global decision nodes k=0,...,63, one state per independent clipped-innovation reference trajectory
training.pilot_scope: R15 training recipe is inherited unchanged apart from declared economic parameters; R16 exact-HJB derivative/manufactured diagnostics use separate development domains.
training.postdecision_time_input: after-decision date t_(k+1); state input is pre-noise postdecision mean x_k
training.randomness: SHA256 domain-separated complete streams for initialization, occupation, training innovations, optimization, online checks and independent confirmation
training.raw_costate_noise_reduction: antithetic4; every member rollout charged; known terminal-noise control variate has zero average adjustment for paired antithetic costates
training.reference_policy: cell-average analytical schedule M_k/h; frozen for all three stages
training.update_scope: All three registered stages execute; no online payoff selection or retrospective early-stop reconstruction.

work.clock: Fresh parent process from before launch through all durable fit, diagnostics, checkpoint, reload, independent confirmation and result writes.
work.installation_scope: Pinned dependency installation and source extraction occur before the measured child process; imports and all scientific computations occur inside it.
work.shared_hjb: One complete four-candidate selection and distillation package yields two prespecified deployments. Record common fit cost and each deployment/verification cost separately; each standalone deployment is charged the prerequisite selection and fitting work, without pretending the two share independent training runs.
work.summaries: All eight streams, including failures and unattained final targets; no successful-only work average.
work.timing_scope: Observed environment-specific full work, not equal FLOPs or hardware-invariant runtime.
